subject: gk
question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?

options.text: FIH Men Hockey World Cup 2023 – India

solution:
The correct answer is __**FIFA World Cup Football 2022 – Japan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FIFA World Cup Football 2022** was held in **Qatar**, not Japan.
 
• The **Commonwealth Games 2022** were hosted by **England**.
 
• The **Olympics 2020** took place in **Tokyo**.
 
• The **FIH Men Hockey World Cup 2023** was conducted in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **FIFA World Cup** is held every four years and is one of the most prestigious football tournaments globally.
 
• Qatar was the first Middle Eastern country to host the FIFA World Cup.
 
• The **Commonwealth Games** is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The **Olympic Games** are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• The **FIH Men Hockey World Cup** is an international field hockey competition organized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
